subject: design/workbench-ui-v1
statement: The reading room is **one zero-dependency Node process in the managed system footprint** (design-brainstorm:workbench-ui-tech-design#D-1, #D-2, #D-3). It reads the corpus **directly, machine-faces-first** — the generated one-writer JSON contracts (ledger projections, the design index's machine face, plan folds) are the primary inputs, and hand parsing exists only for the classes that have no machine face, confined to a **class registry** that is the sole home of class knowledge. It serves **server-rendered pages over loopback**, guarded by a per-session secret in the URL path and Host validation; document bodies come from the **committed renderers, composed** (the codified doc renderer in-runtime; the plan renderer's self-contained page via the Go binary, probe-and-degrade). It writes nothing inside the repository but gitignored scratch, exits with its terminal or on idle, and hands annotation to the doc-review loop by presenting the exact invocation — never running it. No Go component, no build step, no runtime npm dependency.
